commands.command: /usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in /rules/node_modules/homecheck/docs/{avoid-empty-callback-check,remove-container-without-property-check,remove-redundant-state-var-check,remove-unchanged-state-var-check,use-onAnimationStart-for-swiper-preload-check,use-reusable-component-check}.md; do echo "=== $f"; sed -n '"'1,220p' \""'$f"; done'
/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[].files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json | sort -u); do echo \"===== "'$f"; nl -ba "$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule|contains(\"remove-redundant\")) | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json | sort -u); do echo \"===== "'$f"; rg -n '"'@State|build\\(|onPageShow|onClick|this\\.' \""'$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule|contains(\"remove-unchanged\")) | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json | sort -u); do echo \"===== "'$f"; rg -n '"'@State|build\\(|onPageShow|onClick|this\\.' \""'$f"; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule|contains(\"remove-unchanged\")) | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json | sort -u); do echo \"===== "'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'15,45p'; done"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule|contains(\"remove-redundant\") or contains(\"remove-unchanged\")) | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json | sort -u); do echo \"===== "'$f"; rg -n '"'@State|"'^'"\\s*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*:' \""'$f" | head -80; done'

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'for f in $(jq -r '"'.rules[] | select(.rule|contains(\"remove-unchanged\")) | .files[].relative_path' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json | sort -u); do printf '%s\\t' \""'$f"; jq -r --arg f "$f" '"'.rules[] | select(.rule==\"@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var\") | .files[] | select(.relative_path=="'$f) | [.locations[].line] | join(",")'"' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json; done"
/usr/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const m of ['ajv','ajv-formats']) { try { console.log(m, require.resolve(m)); } catch (_) { console.log(m, 'missing'); } }\""

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'all(.entity_repairs[]; has(\"rule\") and has(\"relative_path\") and ((.locations|length)>0) and ((.entities|length)>0) and ((.evidence|length)>0) and (.transformation|length>0) and .status == \"repaired\") and (.blocked|length == 0) and (.unresolved_external|length == 0)' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json >/dev/null && echo schema-required-fields-ok"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'plan_rules=$(jq -c '"'[.rules[].rule]' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json); report_rules="'$(jq -c '"'.selected_rules' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json); test \""'$plan_rules" = "$report_rules" && echo selected-rules-match || { echo selected-rules-mismatch; printf '"'%s\\n%s\\n' \""'$plan_rules" "$report_rules"; exit 1; }'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq empty .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json && echo json-valid; jq -r '[.selected_rules[], (.entity_repairs[].rule)] | unique | length' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json; jq -r '.entity_repairs | length' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc 'plan_locs=$(jq -c '"'[.rules[] as "'$r | $r.files[] as $f | $f.locations[] | {rule:$r.rule,path:$f.relative_path,line:.line,column:.column}] | sort_by(.rule,.path,.line,.column)'"' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json); report_locs="'$(jq -c '"'[.entity_repairs[] as "'$r | $r.locations[] | {rule:$r.rule,path:$r.relative_path,line:.line,column:.column}] | sort_by(.rule,.path,.line,.column)'"' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json); test \""'$plan_locs" = "$report_locs" && echo locations-match || { echo locations-mismatch; diff <(printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$plan_locs") <(printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$report_locs"); exit 1; }'

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '[.rules[].files[].locations[]] | length' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json; jq '[.entity_repairs[].locations[]] | length' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json; jq '[.entity_repairs[].evidence[] | select(type "'!= "string" or length == 0)] | length'"' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -e 'has(\"repository_evidence\") | not and all(.entity_repairs[]; (has(\"evidence\") and (.evidence|type==\"array\") and all(.evidence[]; type==\"string\" and length>0)))' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json >/dev/null && echo evidence-shape-ok"

/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq -e '((has(\"repository_evidence\") | not) and all(.entity_repairs[]; (has(\"evidence\") and (.evidence|type == \"array\") and all(.evidence[]; (type == \"string\" and length > 0)))))' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json >/dev/null && echo evidence-shape-ok"

coverage.feedback: Every required rule, file, and exact evaluator location is accounted for.
